<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Slurp Up](/Feats.aspx?ID=5480) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 75

**Archetype** [Thlipit Contestant](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=224)

**Prerequisites**
[Thlipit Contestant Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5474); unarmed attack with your tongue

</column>

---

Your tongue darts out in search of refreshment. Choose a liquid container of up to light Bulk within reach of your lash, such as a [potion](/Traits.aspx?ID=672) or [elixir](/Traits.aspx?ID=589). The container must be held or in the open, not stowed in a pack or bandoleer. If the container is unattended or held by a willing ally, you Interact to drink the contents. If the container is held by an unwilling creature, you must succeed on a check using your [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719) attack modifier or [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=50) modifier against the creature's Reflex DC to drink the contents; this adds the [attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=540) trait.
name: Slurp Up
prerequisite: Thlipit Contestant Dedication; unarmed attack with your tongue
